# OmniTune v0.8.2

This release focuses on final UI polish and player reliability after v0.8.1.

## Changes

- Refined the dark OmniTune visual direction across Home, Search, collection pages, Library, Stats, History, Settings, MiniPlayer, and Player surfaces.
- Reduced heavy borders and over-glass surfaces so music artwork and compact rows remain the primary visual focus.
- Improved fullscreen Player scaling so artwork, controls, and bottom actions fit better on tall Android devices.
- Fixed the fullscreen Player bottom actions row so Like, Download, Audio Effects, Lyrics, Sleep Timer, and Queue remain visible and readable.
- Improved the Lyrics bottom sheet loading state so it no longer appears as an empty blank panel while lyrics are resolving.

## Download

- `OmniTune-v0.8.2-release.apk`
- `OmniTune-v0.8.2-release.apk.sha256`

## Notes

- The release APK is built and signed by GitHub Actions using the repository release secrets.
- The APK filename is compatible with OmniTune's in-app updater.
